candidates.change_summary: Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers any funds.
Replace address(this).balance with depositsCount so withdrawAll transfers the deposits count instead of the full balance.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so anyone can withdraw the entire balance.
Invert the ownership check so require(msg.sender != owner), causing withdrawAll to revert for the owner and succeed for others.
Delete the require statement so the modifier imposes no restriction and anyone can call withdrawAll.
Invert the access-control condition so require(msg.sender != owner) lets anyone except the owner call withdraw.
Transfer the withdrawn value to owner instead of msg.sender, changing who receives the funds when withdraw is called by the owner.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw becomes a no-op and the contract balance is unchanged after the call.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier invocation so any address can call withdraw and drain funds.
